intent: The message a Command shows while no item is visible.
typical_uses: A "No results found." line in a CommandList

dont_use_when.situation: An empty state of a page, a table or a panel, outside a Command

invariants.text: The component renders only while the root counts no item: with search text, while no item matches it; with an empty search or `shouldFilter={false}`, while no item is registered at all. Items with `forceMount` are not counted. Otherwise it renders nothing.

anti_patterns.dont: Render the empty message conditionally by hand
anti_patterns.do_instead: Always render CommandEmpty; it shows and hides itself from the root's own count

children.states: children is the message shown while no item is visible
children.because: `React.ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

good.title: An empty message in a list

bad.title: An empty message shown by the caller's own check
bad.why: `items` is the full list, not what the search left visible, so the message never shows while filtering; CommandEmpty already reads the root's own count.
